# atomic_sections { #timetoalign.timelines.atomic_sections }

```python
timelines.atomic_sections(
    registry,
    length,
    *,
    believer=None,
    beliefs=DEFAULT_BELIEFS,
)
```

Return the stretches of the axis that flow control never divides.

The intervals between consecutive boundaries: 0, the length, the
coordinates of Jumps, JumpTargets, Breaks and SectionBreaks, and the
places of every destination other than ``by: 0``. They are lettered in
the order of the axis; a run of a flow is the atomic sections it covers.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                                                  | Description                                                                                             | Default           |
|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| registry | [FlowControlRegistry](`timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol.FlowControlRegistry`)                        | The flow control.                                                                                       | _required_        |
| length   | [_Number](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine._Number`) \| [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | The length of the axis, as for :func:`play`.                                                            | _required_        |
| believer | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                  | The actor whose beliefs alone decide which elements are read; None reads the elements no actor rejects. | `None`            |
| beliefs  | [Collection](`collections.abc.Collection`)\[[BeliefState](`timetoshare.BeliefState`)\]                | With a believer, the belief states read.                                                                | `DEFAULT_BELIEFS` |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description      |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | As :func:`play`. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.core import Coordinate
>>> from timetoalign.timelines.flowcontrol import (
...     FlowControlRegistry, Jump, JumpDestination)
>>> registry = FlowControlRegistry(unit="quarters")
>>> _ = registry.add(
...     Jump(Coordinate(8, "quarters"), [JumpDestination(repeat_count=1)]))
>>> [(s.name, s.start.value, s.end.value) for s in atomic_sections(registry, 12)]
[('A', Fraction(0, 1), Fraction(8, 1)), ('B', Fraction(8, 1), Fraction(12, 1))]
```
